findings.note: The Jazz's official preview lists Giannis as probable with a right wrist sprain and says injuries have thinned Utah's frontcourt rotation. That points to a soft interior matchup for him.

On Nov 9, Giannis was listed as probable for Utah with a right wrist sprain. He has been on recent injury reports but has not missed a game, and he scored 29 against Sacramento and 30 earlier in the week.
ESPN's game page shows Giannis averaging 27.5 points this season, below the 28.5 line, with 62.2% free-throw shooting. It also lists him as day-to-day with a wrist injury.
